messages:
sam_cs: Hey team — forwarded a user report: they tried to redeem promo 'WELCOME50' during checkout and got "Promo code invalid or expired". Customer email: alex+trial@clientco.com. Happened at 2024-11-29 22:08 UTC. Screenshot attached in original thread.
adele_billing: Can you paste the exact error payload they saw? any error code from the checkout UI/API?
sam_cs: They pasted this: `Error: PROMO_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED (code 4101)`. Frontend shows a toast: 'This code is invalid or has expired.' No order attempted.
kevin_infra: I can take a look in the promo service logs — do we have the code value (customer redacted it as WELCOME50)? that should be enough.
sam_cs: Yup code is WELCOME50. Customer says they got an email with the code yesterday and tried today.
lisa_eng: Quick note: there was a batch job yesterday that migrated legacy coupons and adjusted expire semantics. tagging @kevin_infra to check if that changed inclusive/exclusive boundaries.
kevin_infra: Running a quick DB check: `SELECT code, expires_at, timezone FROM promotions WHERE code = 'WELCOME50';` returning `expires_at = 1701360000` (UTC midnight), created_by = promotions_migrate_job. That TTL resolves to 2024-11-30 00:00:00 UTC.
kevin_infra: If frontend compares local date <= expires_at and user in PST tried on 2024-11-29 17:05 PST (which is 2024-11-30 01:05 UTC), that would be after UTC midnight. but customer reported 22:08 UTC which is before. hmm.
adele_billing: Could it be the migration set expires_at to the day after but we treat deadline as exclusive somewhere? i.e. if expires_at is stored as 00:00 next day and validation does `now >= expires_at` then code is considered expired at midnight UTC. That's still consistent though.
sam_cs: Customer insists they tried before midnight UTC. They gave a local timestamp + screenshot but maybe client clock is off. They want a manual credit if we can't fix quickly.
kevin_infra: I'm going to check the promo validator service logs around their attempt. ops-bot: ran alert for promo-service and returned last deploy id.
ops-bot: Promo service: last deploy 2024-11-28T18:12:03Z. No rolling restarts since then.
kevin_infra: Found the specific validation trace by searching for user email hash in auth logs. There is an API call at 2024-11-29T22:07:59Z with `promo=WELCOME50` and the validator returned {"status":"rejected","reason":"expired","validator_ts":1701360000}. So validator saw it as expired.
lisa_eng: Can you dump the validator's system time and timezone? might be a DST/local tm bug or the migration created an off-by-one where we set expires_at at local midnight but stored as UTC midnight incorrectly.
kevin_infra: System time is UTC. The problematic bit looks like the migration incorrectly interpreted date-only promos as local-midnight in the server's default timezone during import, then converted to UTC without normalizing. That can make some promos end 24 hours early in certain regions.
adele_billing: This matches a subset of tickets from yesterday. We flagged ~7 codes migrated by promotions_migrate_job. Looks like WELCOME50 was one of them.
sam_cs: Customer is on the trial and asks for immediate resolution — manual credit + letting them complete onboarding. Can we issue a manual +$50 credit and notify?
adele_billing: I can do a manual grant. I need the account id. sam_cs, can you confirm account id or stripe customer id?
sam_cs: Account id: acct_01GZ9XKABC, stripe id on file `cus_JyZx78`.
adele_billing: Granting manual credit now: `POST /billing/manual_credit` payload: { "account_id": "acct_01GZ9XKABC", "amount_cents": 5000, "reason": "promo_migration_expiry_bug" }
adele_billing: Done — credit applied. Transaction id: tx_5f9b2. Customer notified with apology and a one-time code `WELCOME50-MANUAL` to use.
kevin_infra: I'll open an internal bug: promotions-migrate off-by-one timezone conversion. Assigning to @lisa_eng to lead rollback/fix.
lisa_eng: Working on a fix — plan: (1) identify all migrated promos with the date-only flag, (2) re-normalize expires_at to end-of-day UTC (23:59:59) for promos intended to be inclusive, (3) add unit test and regression to prevent import-time tz conversion.
kevin_infra: Also adding a short-term mitigation: validator will accept codes with expires_at within 24h of now if created by promotions_migrate_job and flagged 'date_only' — to avoid breaking onboarding while we fix.
sam_cs: Great. I've replied to the customer that credit is applied and eng is on a fix. They appreciated the quick turnaround. :thumbsup: :party:
lisa_eng: Filed issue INFRA-3246, PR incoming, rolling patch planned in next deploy window.
kevin_infra: Closing loop here — will post back when deploys are live.
ops-bot: Incident created: promotions-migration-timezone (severity: low) — assigned to lisa_eng and kevin_infra.
